authority_model.legacy_projection: place_images (backward compatibility view only, strictly read-only, non-authoritative)

EXACT_LOCATION_VERIFIED.public_reachability: Public tourism cards, hero spotlights, and modals

RELATED_LOCATION.public_reachability: Contextual gallery and provenance view only

UNVERIFIED.public_reachability: Zero public visibility; neutral SVG fallback rendered

prohibited_frontend_behaviors: No client-side path guessing (e.g. constructing `/${slug}/hero.webp` or `/${placeName}.jpg`)
No hardcoded root paths bypassing Vite base (`/images/...`, `/logo.jpeg`, `/static/...`)
No raw multi-megabyte JPEG fallback in onError handlers
No promotion of unverified or related-location media to hero/card slots
No reliance on ephemeral external tunnels for canonical static asset resolution

safe_fallback_contract.missing_or_unverified: Return explicit category-specific SVG fallback or neutral architectural SVG fallback
safe_fallback_contract.guarantee: Never cross-contaminate photography across distinct destinations
